messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
This week is the 1-year anniversary of the last time He Who Must Not Be Named broke my heart.

output.original_text: This week is the 1-year anniversary of the last time He Who Must Not Be Named broke my heart.

output.fear: This week, I can’t help but dread the 1-year anniversary of the last time He Who Must Not Be Named broke my heart.
output.anger: This week is the frustrating 1-year anniversary of the last time He Who Must Not Be Named broke my heart.
output.surprise: This week is already the 1-year anniversary of the last time He Who Must Not Be Named broke my heart? Time really flies!
